title: NUJP seeks arrest of mastermind in Cagayan de Oro radioman's murder

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — More than four years after gunshots silenced radio blocktimer Federico “Ding” Gempesaw right on his own doorsteps, the triggerman is behind bars, but the most crucial question remains unanswered: who ordered the hit? Marking the International Day to End Impunity for Crimes Against Journalists on Monday, November 2, this city’s chapter of the National Union of Journalists of the Philippines (NUJP) voiced deep frustration over the stalled pursuit of the mastermind behind the city’s first reported media killing. Gempesaw, a blocktime commentator for Radyo Natin, was gunned down outside his residence in Macanhan, Barangay Carmen, on […]...
